name: cameron-aaron-portfolio
description: Cameron Aaron's personal portfolio site — Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
author: Cameron Aaron

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: node scripts/verify/verify-lockfile-sync.mjs && pnpm run security:leaks:staged && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run test:mutation:changed
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: node scripts/verify/verify-lockfile-sync.mjs && pnpm run security:leaks:staged && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run test:mutation:changed && pnpm run security:leaks:history && pnpm run build && node scripts/checks/performance-budgets.mjs

scripts.deploy:pages:prod: pnpm run test:freshness && pnpm run test:performance && pnpm run test:interaction-latency && wrangler pages deploy out --project-name cameronaaronsite --branch=master
scripts.test:complexity: vitest run src/complexity-doctrine-contract.test.ts src/components/algorithm-and-datastructure-contract.test.tsx src/components/animation-regression-contract.test.ts src/modularization-contract.test.ts src/dead-logic-export-contract.test.ts src/dead-dependency-contract.test.ts src/public-asset-weight-contract.test.ts src/config-integrity-contract.test.ts src/docs-quality-contract.test.ts src/lifecycle-hygiene-contract.test.ts src/headers-integrity-contract.test.ts src/test-quality-contract.test.tsx src/external-links-contract.test.ts
scripts.test:performance:desktop: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:performance:contracts && npx @lhci/cli@0.15.1 autorun --config=lighthouserc.json
scripts.test:performance:mobile: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:performance:contracts && npx @lhci/cli@0.15.1 autorun --config=lighthouserc.mobile.json
scripts.test:performance: pnpm run test:performance:desktop && pnpm run test:performance:mobile
scripts.test:modularization: sh -c 'vitest run src/modularization-contract.test.ts src/module-testability-contract.test.ts src/dead-component-contract.test.ts src/public-assets-freshness-contract.test.ts $(find src/components -type f \( -name \*-logic.test.ts -o -name \*-engine.test.ts -o -name \*-builders.test.ts \) | sort) src/components/projects/FeaturedIcon.test.tsx src/components/contact/SocialPlatformIcon.test.tsx src/components/ui/FloatingBadgeIcon.test.tsx src/components/ui/section-transitions.test.tsx'
scripts.test:a11y:contracts: vitest run src/app/wcag-contract.test.tsx src/app/a11y-regressions.test.tsx src/components/sections-a11y.test.tsx src/components/navigation-a11y.test.tsx src/components/faq-a11y.test.tsx src/components/ui/keyboard-shortcuts.test.tsx
scripts.test:a11y:automated: pnpm run test:a11y:contracts && pnpm run test:a11y:scanners
scripts.test:a11y:ci: pnpm run test:a11y:contracts && pnpm run test:a11y:scanners && pnpm run test:a11y:external
scripts.seo:audit: pnpm run build && pnpm run seo:check && npx @lhci/cli@0.15.1 autorun --config=lighthouserc.json
